# FreeFrontend liquid-glass source manifest

Source collection: https://freefrontend.com/css-liquid-glass/

CodePen documents that public Pens are MIT licensed. The files in `pens/` are
the unmodified full-page outputs used for implementation review. They are not
loaded as remote iframes and do not send application data to CodePen.

| Pen | Author | Production use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| QwbaYGO | DaftPlug (`daftplug`) | exact button displacement filter |
| bNVWoBW | Jhey (`jh3y`) | retained reference: liquid toggle |
| vEOpqMa | Dan Lassiter (`lassiterda`), based on Lucas Romero | exact four-layer surface and SVG refraction |
| jEPxMgW | `shingidad` | retained reference: WebGL shader |
| VYLQJoy | Maxuiux (`maxuiux`) | exact settings range component |
| ZYbQmZN | Cubiq (`thecubiq`) | retained reference: pure CSS/SVG navigation |
| XJbxKQq | Esther K (`Esther-k`) | retained reference: displacement button |
| KwpRaGr | `fooontic` | retained reference: theme switcher |
| gbpzgqX | Ryan Yu (`iamryanyu`) | retained reference: GSAP menu |
| dPodbrX | `supah` | retained reference: React Three Fiber shader |
| NPqwOby | Adam Curzon (`adamcurzon`) | retained reference: pointer-tracked UI |
| MYwQwZZ | `samarkandiy` | retained reference: multilayer glass UI |
| GgJQEKE | Alex Erlandsson (`alexerlandsson`) | retained reference: native draggable glass |
| MYwrMNy | Mikhail Bespalov | retained reference: PNG displacement hover |
| VYLyOLZ | Florian Wölki | retained reference: WWDC25 static distortion |
| EajLxJV | Jhey (`jh3y`) | retained reference: scroll/drag/configuration |

The original `lucasromerodb/liquid-glass-effect-macos` HTML, CSS and README are
also preserved in `lucasromerodb/`. Project-specific selectors and layout
constraints live outside the vendored directory.
